title: Azure CLI patterns
code:
# Build an image in Azure Container Registry
az acr build --registry <registry> --image <repository>:<immutable-tag> .

# Show ACR task logs
az acr task logs --registry <registry> --run-id <run-id>

# Assign a registry pull role to an identity
az role assignment create \
  --assignee <principal-id> \
  --scope <registry-resource-id> \
  --role AcrPull

# Set App Service application settings
az webapp config appsettings set \
  --resource-group <resource-group> \
  --name <app-name> \
  --settings <SETTING_NAME>=<value>

# Stream App Service container logs
az webapp log tail \
  --resource-group <resource-group> \
  --name <app-name>

title: KQL pattern library
code:
// Dependency failures and latency
dependencies
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| summarize total=count(), failures=countif(success == false),
            p95=percentile(duration, 95)
    by type, target
| order by failures desc, p95 desc

traces

title: Cosmos DB SDK recognition pattern
code:
from azure.cosmos import CosmosClient
from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential

credential = DefaultAzureCredential()
client = CosmosClient(account_url, credential=credential)
database = client.get_database_client(database_name)
container = database.get_container_client(container_name)

# Prefer a point read when both values are known.
item = container.read_item(item=item_id, partition_key=partition_key)

# Use parameters, a partition key, and a bounded projection for queries.
query = """
SELECT TOP 10 c.id, c.title, c.embedding
FROM c
WHERE c.tenantId = @tenantId
"""
items = container.query_items(
  query=query,
  parameters=[{"name": "@tenantId", "value": tenant_id}],
  partition_key=partition_key,
)
description: The important sequence is client -> database -> container -> operation: from azure.cosmos import CosmosClient from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential

title: PostgreSQL SDK and resource pattern
code:
from psycopg_pool import ConnectionPool

pool = ConnectionPool(
  conninfo=connection_string,
  min_size=2,
  max_size=20,
  timeout=5,
)

with pool.connection() as connection:
  with connection.cursor() as cursor:
    cursor.execute(
      """
      SELECT id, source_uri, content
      FROM document_chunk
      WHERE tenant_id = %s
      ORDER BY embedding <=> %s
      LIMIT %s
      """,
      (tenant_id, query_vector, result_limit),
    )
    rows = cursor.fetchall()
description: For PostgreSQL, recognize three separate concerns: 1. **Connection:** Use a bounded pool, keep connections warm, and avoid a connection per request. 2. **Query:** Use parameters, appropriate indexes, cancellation, and a result limit.
